hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning and Repair in Hanover Park, IL
hero.sub: A driveway that floods, a backyard that turns into a pond or a yard drain packed with debris. We clean and repair catch basins and the lines that carry the water away. Our office is on Greenbrook Boulevard.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: A catch basin is a chamber under a grate that collects runoff from a yard, driveway or patio. Dirt and leaves settle to the bottom, and the water flows out through a pipe. When the basin fills with debris or the pipe clogs, water backs up onto the lawn, the driveway or toward the house.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: Catch Basins in Hanover Park Yards
blocks.intro: Flat lots in subdivisions from the '70s and '80s depend on yard drains.

items.body: Some lots have basins in corners where water collects.
They settle in the basin over the years.
Old basin tops sink and crack.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Not every soggy Hanover Park yard needs a new catch basin. If water collects because the ground slopes toward the house, regrading may be the real fix. If water collects in a low corner with nowhere to go, a basin and a drain line can carry it away. And if you already have a basin that used to work, it's usually clogged with silt, clippings or a crushed outlet pipe. We'll look at the yard with you and tell you which situation you're in.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Catch Basin Work
blocks.body: A cleaning is the simplest visit. Rebuilding a settled top or replacing a grate takes more. If the outlet line is clogged or broken, clearing or repairing it adds to the job. A new basin depends on where the water can go. We look first and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.answer: Once a year is a good rule, more often if it collects a lot of debris.

items.q: Can a clogged basin flood my basement?
items.answer: Yes. Pooled water near the house can seep in through window wells and foundation cracks.

items.q: Can you replace a broken grate or frame?
items.answer: Yes. We reset or replace the top and the grate.

items.q: Can you add a catch basin where water pools?
items.answer: Often, if there's a place to send the water.

items.q: Where does the catch basin water go?
items.preview: To a storm drain, a ditch or a daylight outlet.
items.answer: It depends on the property. Usually to a storm sewer, a ditch or an outlet lower in the yard. We'll trace it.

items.q: Can downspouts connect to a catch basin?
items.answer: Often, yes. Check village rules first. We'll confirm before connecting anything.

items.q: How much does catch basin work cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the job. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it's a cleaning, a repair or line work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
